ajantv2-module.setup:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    mkdir ${_kernel}
    bsdtar-static -xf %(sourcedir)/ajantv2.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C ${_kernel}

    pushd ${_kernel}
    # This is where patches would go
    # Linux 7.2 removed strncpy() in favor of strscpy().
    # https://github.com/aja-video/libajantv2/commit/434ea72bca772275100ec0556cf4a53d5a3494f6
    # TODO: Remove in next update
    %patch %(pkgdir)/ftbfs-linux-driver-fix-compile-with-kernel-7.2.patch
    popd
done
ajantv2-module.build:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}/driver
    %ccache_zero
    export CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}"
    %make -C linux \
        KDIR="%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/build" \
        KVERSION="${_kernel}" \
        LLVM=1
    %ccache_stats
    popd
done
ajantv2-module.install:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}
    %install_file driver/bin/ajantv2.ko -t %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/drivers/aja/
    %install_file driver/bin/ajardma.ko -t %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/drivers/aja/

    # Manually construct the debug info from the kernel modules
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/debug/.build-id
    pushd %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}
    module_list=()
    while IFS=  read -r -d $'\0'; do
        module_list+=("$REPLY")
    done < <(find . -type f -name "*.ko" -print0)
    for module in "${module_list[@]}"; do
        build_id=$(${READELF} -n ${module} | awk '/Bui/ {print $3}')
        debug_path="%(libdir)/debug/.build-id/${build_id:0:2}/${build_id: 2}.debug"

        pushd $(dirname ${module})
        file=$(basename ${module})

        llvm-objcopy --only-keep-debug "${file}" "${file}.debug"
        llvm-objcopy --add-gnu-debuglink "${file}.debug" "${file}"
        llvm-strip -g --strip-unneeded "${file}"
        %install_file "${file}.debug" "%(installroot)/${debug_path}"
        rm -v "${file}.debug"

        popd
    done
    popd

    # Compress modules with zstd
    find "%(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/" -name '*.ko' -print -exec zstd {} \; -exec rm -v {} \;

    popd
done
ajantv2-module.environment:
# Create list of kernels to build for
declare -a kernels=()
for dir in %(libdir)/kernel/*/; do
    dir=${dir%*/}
    kernels+=(${dir##*/})
done

audit.setup:
# TODO: The audisp-filter and audisp-remote dispatchers (and the zos-remote
# plugin) are dropped because their configuration is not stateless: auditd
# reads the plugin directory from /etc/audit/plugins.d and audisp-remote
# reads /etc/audit/audisp-remote.conf, neither of which falls back to
# %(vendordir). Ship them once stateless support covers their configuration.

%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless.patch

%reconfigure \
    --disable-gssapi-krb5 \
    --disable-legacy-actions \
    --disable-static \
    --disable-zos-remote \
    --with-io_uring \
    --with-libcap-ng \
    --with-nftables \
    --with-python3 \
    --with-vendordir=%(vendordir)
audit.install:
%make_install

# Only the local af_unix and syslog dispatchers are shipped; drop the
# remote and filter ones with their configuration and man pages
rm %(installroot)%(sbindir)/audisp-filter \
   %(installroot)%(sbindir)/audisp-remote \
   %(installroot)%(mandir)/man5/audisp-remote.conf.5 \
   %(installroot)%(mandir)/man8/audisp-filter.8 \
   %(installroot)%(mandir)/man8/audisp-remote.8

# No dispatcher plugins are enabled by default
rm %(installroot)%(sysconfdir)/audit/audisp-filter.conf \
   %(installroot)%(sysconfdir)/audit/audisp-remote.conf
rm -r %(installroot)%(sysconfdir)/audit/plugins.d

# System config is admin-owned; the shipped defaults live in %(vendordir)
%tmpfiles "# Audit daemon"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/audit 0750 root root -"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/audit/plugins.d 0750 root root -"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/audit/rules.d 0750 root root -"
audit.environment:
# auparse builds a helper tool for the host
export CC_FOR_BUILD="$CC"
export CPP_FOR_BUILD="$CPP"
